dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: In accordance with the Regulations Regarding the Coupon Cafeteria, each person can claim one delicious Welfare Meal each day from Bran.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Maintain order and stay in line while claiming your Welfare Meal. Violators will lose Welfare Meal privileges for 3 days.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hey! Isn't it supposed to be a 'delicious' Welfare Meal? My Welfare Meal was anything but delicious! I demand an explanation!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "If you have something to say regarding the Welfare Meals, fill out a report with the receptionist. This board doesn't handle such matters."
